answer: Quick check before I dive in — last time you mentioned work (late November) you'd switched teams internally and were writing Kotlin day to day, wrestling coroutines and Gradle; the Elixir pilot squad was the stint before that. Are you back on the Elixir side now, or is this a supervision question for a different team's services? Either way I'm happy to sketch it out — for a new feature I'd usually start by deciding which processes are genuinely stateful and worth a GenServer, then group them under their own supervisor with a restart strategy that matches how tightly they depend on each other, rather than hanging everything off the top-level tree.
